flora: Kelp Holdfast (the massive, root-like anchor that grips rocks)
Kelp Blades (thick, leathery, wide brown ribbons)
Cross-section (honeycomb-like internal structure of the leathery frond)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the 'rubbery' and 'slick' texture of the kelp; oversized, tactile floatation bulbs; clear quadrant separation.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single large air bladder; Top-Right: The wide, rubbery brown blades; Bottom-Left: The root-like holdfast gripping a grey rock; Bottom-Right: A high-detail cross-section showing the internal honeycomb texture.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, diffused daylight catching the wet, glossy surface of the brown kelp.
